name: hermes-agent
description: The agent that grows with you
one_liner: A personal AI assistant you can chat with from Telegram, Discord, or WhatsApp that remembers your conversations, learns new skills on its own, and can run scheduled tasks like a daily report.
buyer: A solo consultant or small-business owner who wants a personal assistant that lives in the messaging apps they already use, without paying for a full-time virtual assistant or an enterprise AI platform.
business_use_cases: A real estate agent runs it on a cheap VPS so it drafts listing descriptions and answers routine client questions over WhatsApp while they're showing houses.
A small e-commerce owner schedules it to send a daily sales and inventory summary to their Telegram every morning, replacing a manual spreadsheet check.
A niche newsletter writer uses its cross-session memory so it recalls past editions and sources without having to re-paste context every time.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a done-for-you setup service that deploys and configures Hermes Agent on a client's cloud VM with their preferred messaging platform.
Sell pre-built 'skill packs' (e.g. real-estate assistant, e-commerce assistant) built on top of it, licensed per business.

steal_this: This weekend, deploy it on a $5 VPS pre-configured as a WhatsApp assistant for local service businesses (salons, plumbers) that answers FAQs and books appointments, then sell the setup as a productized service.
